definitions.explanation: A bag used to carry purchased goods, whether a reusable bag brought from home or a bag provided at a store.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
{買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}くて→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: The shopping bag is so heavy my hands hurt.

examples.japanese: ⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Since plastic bags became paid, I make sure not to forget my shopping bag.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧ (shopping) and {袋|ぶくろ} (bag). Since Japan made plastic bags (⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧) paid at stores in 2020, the word {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ} is now commonly associated with reusable bags (⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧) that shoppers bring themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧: to bring one's own shopping bag
- {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in a shopping bag
- {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to forget one's shopping bag

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧: plastic bag (at checkout) — the disposable bag provided at the register
- ⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧: reusable bag; eco bag — a loanword commonly used for reusable shopping bags
- ⟦{紙袋|かみぶくろ}→紙袋：09705_kamibukuro⟧: paper bag
